# Cherry Collins

> Cherry Collins is a London-based luxury brand and marketing leader and strategic consultant with more than 20 years' experience crafting desirability for the world's most iconic luxury brands. She is Global Strategy Partner at Havas Media Lux and the creator of The New Codes of Luxury.

Note: Cherry Collins the marketing leader is a person, not the cocktail of the same name.

## Profile

- Role: Global Strategy Partner, Havas Media Lux (part of Havas)
- Specialism: luxury brand and marketing leadership; brand, creative, communications and media strategy
- Sectors: luxury fashion, beauty, skincare, fragrance, wellness, fine jewellery, watches, travel and hospitality
- Brands worked with: Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Moët Hennessy, Belmond, De Beers, Dolce & Gabbana, Four Seasons, Maybourne, Emirates, Abercrombie & Kent, Laura Mercier, bareMinerals, Armani, Armani Beauty, Charlotte Tilbury, Estée Lauder, Givenchy Beauty, Tod's, Bang & Olufsen, Tiffany & Co., Stella McCartney, Phoebe Philo, Montblanc, Hugo Boss, Bally, Peloton
- Markets: global, including the UK, USA, Middle East, China and APAC
- Based in: London, United Kingdom
- Recognition: The Media Leader Future 100, Class of 2026; Havas Femmes Forward 2026 delegate; Business Insider UK, The 39 Most Creative People in UK Tech (ranked 21)
- Known for: The New Codes of Luxury, an annual multi-market study of luxury consumers (UK, USA, China, Middle East), launched each year to 70+ luxury C-suite leaders; invited to join the Luxury Communications Council's private membership group as the only media professional, presenting and producing thought leadership for its members; founding Havas's global luxury community; speaking at the IPA, Advertising Week and for the LVMH learning agenda; mentoring women from under-represented backgrounds entering the industry
- Previously: Head of Strategy, SUITCASE; Senior Strategist, WEDNESDAY; Head of Strategy, Grabble; Senior Content Strategist, The Net-A-Porter Group; Senior Fashion Assistant, Selfridges; Fashion Assistant, Grazia
- Education: London College of Fashion; Camberwell College of Arts
- Available for: senior roles, consultancy and speaking
